content.title: Simple design of adaptive protocols for quantum metrology with limited data
content.abstract: Recent sensing experiments have used a Bayesian notion of precision gain to adapt control parameters for fixed measurements. Here, we advocate a simple design principle based on Personick's minimum mean square loss formalism to extend this procedure in order to include measurement optimisation, determining the optimal measurement for each probe and providing a prior-dependent precision gain to optimise the probe itself.
